failure_modes.name: BMS/cell fault
failure_modes.component: Battery management system and lithium-ion cells
failure_modes.symptoms: Vehicle reports low state-of-charge erratically, unexpected power cutoff under load, swollen pack, or permanent no-start with charger LED fault.
failure_modes.mitigation: Periodic pack resistance/voltage balancing at depot, firmware BMS health polling, quarantine packs with cell delta-V over threshold, and scheduled cell-module replacement before end of rated cycle life.

failure_modes.name: Drum brake wear
failure_modes.symptoms: Increased stopping distance, audible scraping during deceleration, lever/paddle requires excess travel, or brake drag causing reduced range.
failure_modes.mitigation: Scheduled shoe inspection at 1500h service interval, replace worn shoes, adjust actuating cable, and log braking-force telemetry to flag degradation early.

failure_modes.name: IoT/GPS module failure
failure_modes.symptoms: Vehicle goes dark in fleet map, rides cannot be unlocked via app, GPS position jumps or is unavailable, or heartbeat pings stop.
failure_modes.mitigation: Redundant cellular+GNSS health check, remote reboot command, antenna and SIM-slot inspection at service, and swap module on repeated comms loss.

failure_modes.name: Connector corrosion at IP68 limits
failure_modes.symptoms: Intermittent power or sensor dropouts after rain exposure, visible green oxidation at connector faces, elevated resistance readings, or water ingress fault codes.
failure_modes.mitigation: Re-seal connectors with dielectric grease, replace degraded grommets/O-rings, pressure-test IP68 seals at depot, and avoid deep-pressure wash that defeats seals.

failure_modes.name: Vandalism damage
failure_modes.symptoms: Cut wiring, snapped handlebars, stripped QR labels, smashed display, or graffitied/disabled locking mechanism discovered at pickup.
failure_modes.mitigation: Hardened locking, tamper-evident seals, geofenced idle alerts, rapid recovery of mis-parked units, and repair-or-retire triage on damage detection.

failure_modes.name: Solid tire wear
failure_modes.symptoms: Reduced ride cushioning, visible flat spots or chunking, increased vibration transmitted to deck, or accelerated hub bearing wear from poor damping.
failure_modes.mitigation: Rotate wheel positions, replace tires at tread/depth limit, monitor vibration signatures, and standardize on softer-compound tires for smoother fleet ride.
